levels.surface: أبو العباس أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد

notes: Needs ruling (rule 11, narrated encounter where the Imam speaks and acts): inside the story Ali («فقال علي», «وأقبل أمير المؤمنين») speaks and acts; he is in the scene and is not added as a link. The last chain link is «أبيه», the teacher of Ja'far's children, named only by relation
«من كتابه وقرأته عليه» describes how Humayd transmitted and is left out; «- وكان مؤدبا ... -» is an editor's gloss; the Daudi man is unnamed and in the scene
